page_title: ROM 2-1 LEC | AS Roma v Lecce 05/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Andrea Colombo has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+4' 2 - 1 Goal! Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 2:1.
90+3' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Rui Patricio comes off the line to clear the ball away.
90+1' 1 - 1 Goal! Nicola Zalewski is the provider and Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) is the executioner, dispatching the cross into the roof of the net from close in with his head. 1:1.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) makes a strong challenge and Andrea Colombo blows for a foul.
89' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
87' The referee gives a yellow card to Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce).
85' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) decides to keep the ball to himself and weaves through the defence into the box. From there he takes a shot which goes narrowly wide of the target.
84' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wladimiro Falcone, who smothers the ball.
83' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) is caught offside!
81' It's like he was asking for a caution. Ahmed Touba (Lecce) receives a yellow card.
80' Substitution. Ahmed Touba (Lecce) in, Pontus Almqvist out.
80' Substitution. Nikola Krstovic is replaced by Roberto Piccoli (Lecce).
79' A short pass finds Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
78' Substitution. Rick Karsdorp walks off the pitch and Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) comes on as a substitute.
78' Jose Mourinho has decided to make a change. Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) replaces Gianluca Mancini.
78' Here's the change. Stephan El Shaarawy leaves the pitch and Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) comes on as a substitute.
77' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) picks up a yellow card.
77' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Rui Patricio is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
76' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Renato Sanches (AS Roma) was quite harsh and Andrea Colombo didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

75' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Andrea Colombo with no other option than to blow for a foul.
75' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
73' Substitution. Lameck Banda will be replaced by Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce).
73' Jose Mourinho decides to make a substitution. Houssem Aouar will be replaced by Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma).

72' 0 - 1 Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Lameck Banda, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:1.
70' Substitution. Edoardo Bove makes way for Renato Sanches (AS Roma).
69' Paulo Dybala sends the ball into the centre of the box from the corner. Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) bursts through a crowd of players but heads the ball miles wide of the left post.
68' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
68' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma). The ball is out of play. AS Roma will have a chance to score from a corner.

67' Rui Patricio makes a good save! Lameck Banda (Lecce) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a low shot from long range. His effort is directed towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and stops it.
66' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
64' Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Romelu Lukaku, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
63' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
62' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Patrick Dorgu is replaced by Antonino Gallo (Lecce).
62' A substitution has been made. Hamza Rafia is replaced by Joan Gonzalez (Lecce).
62' The foul by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) was seen by Andrea Colombo who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
60' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) sends the corner into the box, but Rui Patricio intercepts it and averts the threat.
60' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.
57' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
57' One of the defending players blocks a long-range shot which was unleashed by Pontus Almqvist (Lecce). The ball goes out of play. Lecce are awarded a corner kick.

54' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) receives a lofted pass on the edge of the penalty box and without any hesitation fires the ball goalwards. It fails to worry the goalkeeper as it goes to the middle of the goal.
54' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the middle of the goal is smartly dealt with by Rui Patricio.
52' Wasted opportunity! Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
51' The players claim that Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
48' Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) swings it in and Romelu Lukaku gets on the end of it, but Wladimiro Falcone shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
46' Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Andrea Colombo has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' A cross from Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
42' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Andrea Colombo has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
41' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) sends a long ball in, but Rui Patricio comfortably gathers the ball.
37' The opposing goalkeeper had set up the wall well before the free kick was executed and Lameck Banda (Lecce) failed to send the ball over. Great defensive action!
33' The referee blows his whistle as Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) was too aggressive in his challenge.

32' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
30' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
27' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) has tested the patience of referee Andrea Colombo and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
27' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
26' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to AS Roma.

25' Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) fires a volley towards the right side of the goal from the edge of the penalty box, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AS Roma.
25' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from AS Roma comes to nothing.

25' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Wladimiro Falcone makes a smart save to deny him. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
20' A pass from Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) is intercepted by Rui Patricio and the move breaks down.
17' Lameck Banda (Lecce) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
16' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) tackles a bit over-zealously and Andrea Colombo blows for a foul.
14' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
11' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) commits a rough challenge and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for an infringement.
9' Andrea Colombo has a clear sight and sees a foul from Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma).
5' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the bottom left corner, but Wladimiro Falcone pulls off a superb save.
5' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
4' The AS Roma players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
3' Referee Andrea Colombo makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for AS Roma. Let’s see what happens!
2' Surely that's handball by one of the Lecce players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! AS Roma will take the kick-off.
Andrea Colombo is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
Show lineups
Welcome to our live text commentary, ladies and gentlemen! The starting lineups will be announced very soon, so just sit back and get ready to enjoy the action.
